content: Our basic paragraph-level model wrongly predicted the implicit discourse relation between DU1 and DU2 to be “Implicit-Comparison”, without being able to effectively use the succeeding “Explicit-Temporal” relation. On the contrary, the full model corrected this mistake by modeling discourse relation patterns with the CRF layer.
